title: Focused implementation review
statement: As a reviewer, I can expand a named deck in the Report Saga sidebar, navigate its rendered slide thumbnails, and inspect the exact code behind each explanation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A report can expose several optional decks without rendering user stories or ordinary report fragments as slides.
Only semantic Items own exact diff evidence, including contextual surprise callouts.
The Saga sidebar names each deck with a deck icon; expanding it renders its slide thumbnails, selecting one gives it the full main review area, and slide navigation remains within that deck.
